question: Owen had 102 points in a video game, even though the leaderboard shows a dozen top players. He earned 27 more points defeating a mini-boss. He then lost 74 points falling into a trap. A second trap cost him 45 more points. He found a hidden chest worth 61 points. A side quest added 29 more points. Finally, a final boss victory made his total nine times as large, putting him far ahead of his rival Blake, who only scored 400 points. How many points did Owen end up with?

A person saved 191 dollars initially. They multiplied by 5 through consistent saving. They added 48 from bonuses. Then 15 more arrived from interest. They added 76 from a second job. Finally, they multiplied by 4 for lifetime projections. A wealthy person saved 5000 dollars but different goals. How many dollars in lifetime projection?

In the morning, a warehouse had 191 boxes of canned soup on the loading dock. By midday, a delivery added 15 more boxes. In the afternoon, 123 boxes were shipped out to a grocery chain. That evening, a supply drive turned every remaining box into 4 boxes. Right before closing, 56 more boxes arrived from a late shipment. How many boxes of canned soup were on the loading dock after the late shipment?

A stamp club began the year with 181 albums in its store. Members donated 15 albums, then 17 more, and later another 24. Each album in the store holds 6 rare stamps. A collector then gave the club 29 loose stamps as well. Ines has donated more albums than Karl has, and a dozen members meet every Thursday. How many stamps does the club hold?

The community orchard began the season with 28 apple trees along its west path. The volunteers planted 59 new trees in the spring and another 16 in early summer. Later that year disease forced them to take out 54 trees, which were burned at the edge of the field. Every tree still standing gave 4 crates of apples at harvest. A neighbouring smallholder donated 4 crates of his own to the orchard shop, and the committee bought 78 crates from a farm in the next valley to meet its orders. How many crates did the orchard shop have?

In the morning the nursery had 65 trays and removed 15, checking the count twice. Each tray has 3 rows, and each row has 6 pots. In the afternoon each pot was planted with 3 seedlings. In the evening each seedling showed 6 leaves. How many leaves were counted?

On Monday morning a school kitchen had 200 lunch trays in the rack. A delivery added 48 trays before break, and 8 were dropped and broken. At lunchtime another 48 trays came back from the dining hall. During the afternoon 133 trays were taken to the sports hall for a match. That evening the county ordered enough trays for the school to hold 6 times as many, and the trays were then shared equally between the 3 buildings on the site. Half of the trays are green. How many trays went to one building?
Two colleagues, Alex and Jordan, compare totals. Alex had 48 items. This was multiplied by 5. He removed 21. This was multiplied by 6. He removed 1059. Jordan has fewer. What was his total?

At the Riverside charity walk, each of the 117 walkers raised 9 dollars from sponsors. A bake stall at the finish line brought in another 47 dollars. The route passed a dozen village halls along the river. All of the money raised was then divided equally among 5 local charities. The animal shelter, one of those charities, immediately spent 175 dollars on winter feed. How many dollars did the animal shelter have left?

A grocery store's rice storage held 56 kilograms at the start of Monday morning. By mid-morning, half of that rice had been sold off to a wholesale buyer, leaving only the remaining half in storage. In the afternoon, a delivery truck dropped off 14 more kilograms. Later that afternoon, another supplier brought in 75 additional kilograms. That evening, a supply agreement brought the store's rice total to 7 times what it had been. Just before locking up for the night, the store shipped out 782 kilograms to a partner branch across town, even though that branch is only 3 kilometers away. How many kilograms of rice were left in storage after the shipment?

A bookshelf started with 198 books. During spring cleanup, 166 books were donated to the library. Then Maya bought 78 used books from a garage sale. Later, 49 books were lent to a school, leaving them temporarily. Her family donated 68 books they found in the attic. Finally, 54 books were removed for recycling, and 16 new books were added. The living room had space for 200 more books (but that doesn't affect the count). How many books are on the bookshelf now?

A gardener started with 61 plants initially. She removed 29 to replant elsewhere. She added 64 new seedlings. She divided by 4 for garden sections. She multiplied by 4 for potting. She added 80 more from the nursery. The garden got 8 hours of sun daily. How many plants did she end up with?

Jun scored 193 points in the opening round of the tournament, more than his teammate Kim. A power-up then tripled his score. In the second round every point he held was worth 6 points, in the third round every point was worth 5 points, and in the fourth round every point was worth 5 points again. The tournament rule is that a player's final score is shared equally among the 6 members of his team. How many points did Jun receive from his own final score?

A baker had 37 pastries to start. She added 35 more from morning baking. She multiplied by 7 for gift boxes. She divided by 3 for portion control. She removed 32 for a special order. The shop opened 7 days a week. How many pastries were sold?

A warehouse had 223 boxes initially. They removed 108 for shipping. They multiplied by 3 for storage organization. They multiplied by 6 for distribution. They removed 1393 for a large order. They removed 277 damaged boxes. The facility employed 40 people. How many boxes remaining?

A player had 163 tokens. In round 1, they added 42. They divided by 5 for team distribution. In round 2, they added 46. In round 3, they added 45. They noted a distractor worth 8 tokens. How many tokens per team member?
A nonprofit started with 98 donors. They multiplied by 9, added 74 pledges, 28 mid-campaign, 62 monthly, and 62 late pledges. Converting to hours of effort, how many total pledges?
The kite shop had 93 kites and sold 76. The shop is 30 years old. It received 38 kites, then 4, then 22. The kites were packed equally into 3 boxes. How many kites are in the first box?

Nour keeps more jam jars in her pantry than her neighbour Felix does. She had 135 empty jars at the start of the season, and 98 of them were filled with strawberry jam and given away. A further 29 empty jars were sold at the church fair. Felix then gave her 76 empty jars he no longer wanted. A glassworks doubled her collection of empty jars as a prize for winning the jam competition. Over the winter 139 jars were filled and sent to family, and in the spring 74 empty jars came back to her. How many empty jars does Nour have now?

Two trainers coordinated programs. Starting participants: 45. Divided by 5 for groups. Added 65 from registration. Added 15 walk-ins. Multiplied by 2 for morning and afternoon sessions. Multiplied by 9 for the month. Divided by 6 for even distribution. Morning through evening scheduling. How many per venue daily?
A store had 124 items. She removed 120. She multiplied by 4. She removed 3. She removed 8 more. How many items?

On Monday morning Freya's team cut 239 sheets of glass, and every sheet gave 6 panes. Before lunch her colleague Piotr, who cuts fewer sheets than Freya does, added 26 panes from his own bench, then 14 more, and in the early afternoon another 19. Later that afternoon a glazing contract took 1460 panes away from the workshop. In the evening 17 panes cracked while they were being loaded onto the van. How many panes are left?

A delivery service started with 139 packages. They multiplied through 5 collection rounds (695 packages total). In the first sorting phase, 72 packages were added (767 packages). The second phase added 77 more packages (844 packages). These were then multiplied by 5 to represent all regional routes (4220 packages). Each route then handled one-fifth of the total, consolidating back to the base amount. Converting packages to metric tons, the average weight was triple the starting count. How many packages per route?

A factory started with 32 units. They tripled. They divided by 3. They removed 20 units. They increased 6 times. They removed 48 units. Finally, they divided by 6. His partner had 500 units. How many units do they have?

A single toy factory pallet started the morning with 179 action figures. In the morning, 64 more figures were added from a second line. By midday, a bundling machine left the pallet with 6 times as many units. In the afternoon, a regional order multiplied that count by 5, and a second order multiplied it by 2. That evening, a citywide order multiplied the pallet by 3 once more, around the time a rival factory reported shipping 900 units that week, unrelated to this count. How many units were on that pallet by the end of the evening?
